programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting Pei plays a girl hiding from her father while working as a club singer in Japan. Then her father sends someone for her only for the man to fall in love with her.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: After taking a magic pill, a swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night. To make it worse, she has to run after she ruins the wedding of a bandit chief's daughter.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Playfulness abounds and innocence is lost in this tale of two naughty females who grow up and discover boys together.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: Catch this rare gem, a product of Hong Kong-style science fiction, complete with out-of-this-world visual effects.

programme.title: Dragon Swamp

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil

programme.title: Six Assassins

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins

programme.title: The Dragon Missile

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A martial artist joins the police force in order to pursue the man who killed his best friend but it is only years later that he discovers a startling clue.

programme.title: The Female Prince

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer

programme.title: Murder Plot

programme.title: The Tigress of Shaolin

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord

programme.title: Swordswomen Three

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu Lan

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders

programme.title: Janji Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa mula mencari maklumat tentang AR Holdings. Fendi pula mula membuat video tentang produk AR Holdings yang memberi kesan negative kepada para pengguna. Siti mengalami kemalangan dan memerlukan darah. Muhammad yang masih belum mengetahui identiti ibu kepada Arissa menawarkan diri untuk menderma darah. Arissa melihat akan kebaikan Muhammad dan mula berubah fikiran terhadap Muhammad.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan tidak bersetuju dengan cadangan Antasya dan menjelaskan niatnya. Syarfan terharu melihat Antasya yang sarat mengadug gigih membantu Talia yang semakin teruk keadaanya menguruskan diri. Alia enggan menjaga Talia. Nazarin menuduh Alia tidak professional dan tidak layak menjadi nurse.

programme.title: Cek Ombak
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Kika dan Igo, sepasang kekasih yang bertemu melalui aplikasi kencan, namun menghadapi komplikasi rumit ketika orang tua mereka menikah. Hubungan mereka diuji oleh ikatan persaudaraan tiri dan penolakan orang tua.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Tengku Maria menjadi semakin bimbang melihat keadaan Iskandar yang semakin tidak bermaya dan tidak terurus. Dia minta Haziq untuk kembali ke Kuala Lumpur dan menasihati Iskandar, namum Haziq enggan pulang selagi dia tidak dapat membawa Aisyah pulang bersama. Haziq juga masih terluka dengan ungkitan yang disebut oleh Iskandar tentang asal usulnya. Iskandar masih menanti dan sentiasa mencari Aisyahy, setiap malam dia bermimpi akan Aisyah yang datang menemuinya dan kembali semula ke kondo itu. Iskandar kesal, dia nekad untuk menebus segala khilafnya sekiranya Aisyah kembali kepadanya. Aisyah masih enggan pulang ke Kuala Lumpur, dia bertegas bahawa dia tidak mengenali Haziq dan sesiapa di Kuala Lumpur itu. Anim dan Azri cuba meyakinkan Aisyah namun sering kali gagal. Tanpa diduga, Rokiah dan Sarip berat hati untuk melepaskan Aisyah pergi. Di sebalik layanan baik Rokiah dan Sarip terhadap Aisyah, sebenarnya mereka pernah kehilangan anak perempuan mereka ketika berusia 6 tahun akibat kemalangan jalan raya. disebabkan itu mereka sangat menyanyangi Aisyah dan bersyukur ingatan Aisyah membolehkan Aisyah kembali kepada memori dia bersama arwah ibu dan ayahnya. Haziq mengambil keputusan untuk memberitahu hal itu kepada Tengku Maria, berita itu membuatkan Tengku Maria gembira dan tidak sabar untuk menyambut kepulangan Aisyah. Namun Haziq tidak memberitahu perihal ingatan Aisyah yang sudah hilang memorinya. Anim, Azri, Rokiah, Sarip dan Amani bersetuju untuk bersama membawa Aisyah ke Kuala Lumpur demi menjamin keselamatan Aisyah dan kejujuran Haziq yang mahu Aisyah pulang ke Kuala Lumpur.

programme.desc: Pertemuan semula yang menyayat hati dengan Sarah memaksa Uwan berdepan dengan satu babak pahit dalam hidupnya. Pada 1988, Jali dan kumpulannya menyerang hendap Laila dan Shafiq, memaksa mereka berjuang untuk menyelamatkan nyawa.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah terkejut melihat sepasang kasut perempuan di luar pintu rumah Lukman. Farahhilang sabar dan 'naik hantu' sebaik melihat Myra ada di ruang tamu. FarahdenganMyra bertengkar. Namun, Farah lebih sentap apabila Lukman seakan menyebelahi Myra. Kak Yati seakan tidak percaya dengan aduan Farah dan menganggap ada salah faham.

programme.title: RONDA RODA
programme.desc: Ronda Roda kali ini, menampilkan kereta Hyundai, Prelova Studio dan Kawasaki Versys 650. Yang dihoskan oleh Mira Rizam dengan mempamerkan kereta baru dari Hyundai Tucson dan hasil tangan dari Adie dan Faris.

programme.title: Aroma Masak
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil bersama Arwan akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Daging Lada Hitam & Wantan Jejari Ketam.

programme.title: Pemuja Rahsia
programme.desc: Adam, pelajar kolej yang popular dan juara debat, gemar menyertai marathon. Hawa, jiran Adam, sudah lama menyukai Adam selepas dia menyelamatkannya daripada lemas 18 tahun lalu. Namun, selepas kematian ayah Hawa, ibu Hawa, Suzana, enggan berhubung rapat dengan keluarga Adam, walaupun ayah Adam, Zul, beberapa kali cuba mendekatinya. Hawa percaya dia dan Adam ditakdirkan bersama, tetapi mereka jarang berkomunikasi. Hawa seorang gadis pendiam, gemar warna hitam, mekap pelik, dan muzik

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Tengku Maria menjadi semakin bimbang melihat keadaan Iskandar yang semakin tidak bermaya dan tidak terurus. Dia minta Haziq untuk kembali ke Kuala Lumpur dan menasihati Iskandar, namum Haziq enggan pulang selagi dia tidak dapat membawa Aisyah pulang bersama. Haziq juga masih terluka dengan ungkitan yang disebut oleh Iskandar tentang asal usulnya. Iskandar masih menanti dan sentiasa mencari Aisyahy, setiap malam dia bermimpi akan Aisyah yang datang menemuinya dan kembali semula ke kondo itu. Iskandar kesal, dia nekad untuk menebus segala khilafnya sekiranya Aisyah kembali kepadanya. Aisyah masih enggan pulang ke Kuala Lumpur, dia bertegas bahawa dia tidak mengenali Haziq dan sesiapa di Kuala Lumpur itu. Anim dan Azri cuba meyakinkan Aisyah namun sering kali gagal. Tanpa diduga, Rokiah dan Sarip berat hati untuk melepaskan Aisyah pergi. Di sebalik layanan baik Rokiah dan Sarip terhadap Aisyah, sebenarnya mereka pernah kehilangan anak perempuan mereka ketika berusia 6 tahun akibat kemalangan jalan raya. disebabkan itu mereka sangat menyanyangi Aisyah dan bersyukur ingatan Aisyah membolehkan Aisyah kembali kepada memori dia bersama arwah ibu dan ayahnya. Haziq mengambil keputusan untuk memberitahu hal itu kepada Tengku Maria, berita itu membuatkan Tengku Maria gembira dan tidak sabar untuk menyambut kepulangan Aisyah. Namun Haziq tidak memberitahu perihal ingatan Aisyah yang sudah hilang memorinya. Anim, Azri, Rokiah, Sarip dan Amani bersetuju untuk bersama membawa Aisyah ke Kuala Lumpur demi menjamin keselamatan Aisyah dan kejujuran Haziq yang mahu Aisyah pulang ke Kuala Lumpur.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Demi ibunya, Rizrin berhijrah ke KL selepas melepaskan kekasihnya, Ariyana, kepada abangnya. Sementara itu, Ariyana gagal melupakan Rizrin dan melarikan diri daripada abang Rizrin.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Mama sekali lagi diserang 'heart attack' hingga terpaksa dibawa ke hospital. Farah makan hati melihat Lukman datang bersama Myra untuk melawat Mama. Famili Lukman juga terkejut dengan keberanian Lukman seolah-olah memberi isyarat bahawa hubungannya dengan Myra adalah serius

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Fatimah dimarahi ibunya kerana terus berkawan dan keluar dengan Jazlee dan memberi nasihat supaya tidak kecewa bila direject oleh ibunya nanti. Khadijah, dengan rasa penuh kecewa dan sedih minta Jazlan untuk tidak membatalkan pernikahannya dengan Qasih yang telahpun dirancang dan diatur oleh kedua-dua ibu masing-masing. Aishah memberitahu Jazlee yang ibunya tidak benarkan langkah bendul dengan niat untuk memikat Jazlee untuk dirinya sendiri. Dengan lakonan yang amat menyedihkan, Alawiyah berjaya memujuk Jazlan untuk terus menikahi Qasih

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Talia menangis dan mengaku kekhilafan dirinya di hadapan Antasya. Dia telah melukakan hati Syarfan namun setelah hati Syarfan terubat dengan kehadiran Antasya dia cuba merampas Syarfan semula. Syarfan dan Nazreth bebincang. Nazareth mengakui dia menyukai Antasya . Namun perasaan suka tersebut menjadi hormat apabila melihat hati luhur Antasya. Syarfan dan Antasya juga saling berdamai.

programme.title: Pemuja Rahsia
programme.desc: Adam, pelajar kolej yang popular dan juara debat, gemar menyertai marathon. Hawa, jiran Adam, sudah lama menyukai Adam selepas dia menyelamatkannya daripada lemas 18 tahun lalu. Namun, selepas kematian ayah Hawa, ibu Hawa, Suzana, enggan berhubung rapat dengan keluarga Adam, walaupun ayah Adam, Zul, beberapa kali cuba mendekatinya. Hawa percaya dia dan Adam ditakdirkan bersama, tetapi mereka jarang berkomunikasi. Hawa seorang gadis pendiam, gemar warna hitam, mekap pelik, dan muzik

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Pertemuan antara Tengku Maria dan keluarga baharu Aisyah memberi kesan yang mendalam buat diri Tengku Maria, alangkah hinanya dia sebagai seorang manusia yang menjadi penyebab wanita yang tidak bersalah hilang semua memorinya. Tengku Maria terduduk sayu apabila mendapat tahu kebenaran tentang keadaan Aisyah yang sebenar. Ketika kepulangan Aisyah ke kondo yang pernah menjadi sangkar dalam hidupnya, menjadikan Aisyah seorang yang panas baran. Dia bukan lagi Aisyah yang menjadi penurut segala kata Iskandar. Pertemuan pertama selepas 4 bulan berpisah di antara Aisyah dan Iskandar, benar-benar mengejutkan Iskandar bahawa isterinya itu langsung tidak mampu untuk mengingatinya, malah pelukan pertama selepas berpisah yang di hadiahkan oleh Iskandar kepada Aisyah di balas dengan satu tumbukan kuat di perut Iskandar. Iskandar redha jika jalan ini yang harus di lalui, dia termenung panjang memikirkan bagaimana cahaya hidupnya kini sudah tidak lagi mengingatinya. Setelah 2 hari di kondo, keluarga baharu Aisyah pulah semula ke kampong, kepulangan mereka membuatkan Aisyah sakit merindu. Kini Aisyah hanya hidup dalam memori bersama keluarga baharunya itu. Berat untuk berpisah namun Rokiah, Sarip, Anim, Azri dan Amani akur dan terpaksa juga melepaskan Aisyah untuk terus bersama dengan Iskandar. Sinar bahagia buat Iskandar kini kembali tetapi tidak buat Aisyah. Iskandar mula berusaha untuk mengembalikan ingatan Aisyah dengan setiap kenangan pahit dan manis yang pernah dilalui oleh Aisyah, namun usaha itu sering kali gagal.

programme.title: Aroma Masak

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Ariyana akur berkahwin dengan Azz walaupun masih menyayangi Rizrin. Bagi menyelamatkan keadaan, Rizrin mendesak ibunya mencari calon isteri lain. Sementara itu, pinangan Ryan terhadap Dara dibatalkan akibat keburukannya. Akhirnya, keluarga menetapkan perkahwinan antara Rizrin dan Dara, namun Ryan nekad mahu menghalangnya.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Liza seakan tidak percaya apabila Nazim mengadu apa yang berlaku kepada Farah. Dia bersimpati dan dapat merasai beban yang ditanggung Farah. Mengenangkan apa yang Lukman lakukan membuatkan Farah jadi makin jauh hati. Dia mula memikirkan masa depannya dan nekad untuk meneruskan hasrat menyambut pengajian di UK demi menenangkan jiwanya.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Jazlan dan Qasih selamat melangsungkan pernikahan mereka dan masuk ke dalam bilik Jazlan cuba untuk bersyarah mengenai hukum hakam agama yang Qasih perlu lakukan tetapi Qasih terlebih dahulu menyuarakan kehendak beliau dan syarat-syarat beliau di dalam perkahwinan mereka. Selepas balik dari rumah mama Qasih, Jazlan mengarahkan Qasih untuk menutup aurat dan memakai tudung. Beberapa hari kemudian Jazlan membawa Qasih balik ke Madinah. Jazlan dan Qasih mula menjalani hidup mereka sebagai suami isteri, dengan Jazlan sentiasa menitikberatkan tanggungjawab kepada agama dan tanggungjawab isteri terhadap suami

programme.title: The Swindlers
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penipu bersatu untuk memburu penipu terkenal yang diketahui mati, di tengah-tengah motif tersembunyi dan penipuan mereka.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP2
programme.desc: Nadirah dan Farhan merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang sudah lama mendambakan cahaya mata. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad (Que Haidar), penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP5
programme.desc: Zacky terkesan dengan kematian adiknya Aeera. Dia menyalahkan Ritz dan Affiyah atas apa yang berlaku. Tindakan Rafeeq cuba membunuh Affiyah tergendala dengan kemunculan seorang jururawat. Affiyah yang terlantar dihospital akhirnya meninggal setelah diganggu dengan mimpi ngeri serta mimpi bertemu arwah ibunya.Ritz bersedih atas pemergian adiknya dan Zacky pula terbaring tidak sedarkan diri menerima berita tentang Affiyah. Rafeeq mula terasa kesal atas perbuatannya terhadap Affiyah selama ini

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama (AMTA) bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China III
programme.desc: Tuan Wong dan pengikutnya mendaftar dalam 'Dancing Lion Competition' untuk menghentikan plot pembunuhan dan melawan lawan yang sombong dan penipu.

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain (Haji Zul Ariffin), ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK) yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian (Nur Fazura), ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra (Farid Kamil), yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie (Izara Aishah) dan Jiman (Iedil Putra), Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.title: Ceroboh

programme.desc: Darma trauma dengan bunuh diri tunangnya, Rose, yang telah dihantui oleh makhluk halus jahat. Roh tersebut secara tidak sengaja dibebaskan oleh pasangan itu selepas mereka menemui sebuah balang kecil yang terdampar di pantai. Selepas kematian Rose, Darma membawa balang itu bersamanya, tanpa disedari telah membawa roh tersebut ke dalam hidupnya. Apabila Nissan melancarkan pertandingan mencari bakat baharu, Jann terpilih untuk menyertai kem latihan elit di bawah bimbingan bekas pelumba, Jack Salter. Daripada kerusi gaming ke kokpit kereta lumba sebenar berkelajuan 320 km/j, Jann mesti berdepan tentangan keluarga, persaingan sengit dan bahaya maut di litar lumba. Dia perlu mempertaruhkan nyawa di perlumbaan legenda '24 Hours of Le Mans' untuk membuktikan kepada dunia bahawa dia bukan sekadar seorang pemain video game, tetapi seorang pelumba sejati.

programme.title: Inikah Dikatakan Cinta
programme.desc: Daus berdepan dengan Mia dan meminta penjelasan apakah benar Mia anak haram dan merupakan bekas banduan dan penagih dadah. Mia terpaksa mengakui tetapi memberitahu dia sudah meninggalkan semua itu. Daus tidak percaya. Dia menuduh Mia menipu dan menuduh Mia menggunakannya untuk menutup salah laku lampaunya. programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Jamil dibawa oleh Qistina untuk bertemu dengan Datuk King. Mereka bertemu di sebuah syarikat besar. Datuk King masih mengenangkan kebaikan Jamil yang pernah selamatkan nyawa adiknya. Namun sebenarnya Jamil tidak tahu bahawa Datuk King dan Qistina sudah sepakat untuk mengenakan Jamil. Qistina mencadangkan untuk Jamil menukar pakaian lain yang lebih nampak segak. Jamil minta baju zaman 60annya semula. Namun Qistina menghalang dan minta pengawal peribadi untuk beri pakaian persis seperti seorang CEO. Selepas menukar pakaian, Jamil terasa dirinya kacak dan dia mula berjalan megah mengalahkan Tan Sri.

Anis berterus terang dengan Aleesa yang dia tertarik dengan Badrul tetapi Aleesa membertahu Anis yang Badrul sudah bertunang. Ada cincin tunang di jari Badrul. Anis kecewa tetapi tidak putus asa. Badrul pula gembira bila dia berpeluang bercuti dan berada bersama-sama Aleesa. Di Pulau Perhentian juga Aleesa bertemu dengan rakan sekampungnya, Ana yang hampir berpisah dengan suaminya, Awie kerana orang ke tiga.

programme.title: Inikah Dikatakan Cinta
programme.desc: Mia dikejarkan ke hospital kerana pendarahan setelah dikasari oleh Daus. Walaupun Mia sakit hati tetapi dia berazam untuk menjaga kandungannya dengan baik. Doanya cuma satu, biar anak itu lahir, biar anak itu membuktikan cintanya pada Daus. Namun harapan Mia berkecai apabila Mia keguguran! Daus langsung tidak peduli dengan kesakitan yang dihadapi oleh Mia. Mia terpaksa menguruskan diri sendiri dan pergi ke hospital sendirian. Mia menangis memberitahu Mak Ani tentang berita sedih itu. Ketika Mak Ani datang melawat Mia di hospital, Daus juga tiba2 datang sambil membawa bunga dan di hadapan Mak Ani, Daus minta Mia bersabar dan mereka boleh mencuba lagi untuk mendapatkan anak.

Bertahun kemudian, dia kembali apabila ibu bapanya uzur, namun dendam membuatkan dia sukar memaafkan—hingga kematian ayahnya meninggalkan penyesalan mendalam. Akhirnya, Laila memilih untuk melepaskan luka lama dan menerima ibunya, demi tidak terus hidup dalam penyesalan.

Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: ReakSiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: One,Two,Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuahprogram yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama A.R Badul yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan filem-filem yang diterajuinya.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato' Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato' Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Air Zam Zam Untuk Mak
programme.desc: Mak Jah, seorang guru Al-Quran yang telah menabung dengan Tabung Haji selama 30 tahun demi cita-cita menunaikan haji. Namun sejak tinggal bersama anaknya, Suhaili, dia semakin risau melihat menantu­nya Borhan yang terlalu taksub mengejar kekayaan. Tanpa pengetahuan keluarga, Borhan menerima rasuah dan akhirnya ditangkap, menyebabkan semua akaunnya dibekukan. Selepas Borhan dibebaskan, Mak Jah jatuh sakit. Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahaja—pulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. Mampukah Borhan dan Suhaili menunaikan satu-satunya permintaan seorang ibu yang telah berkorban demi mereka?

programme.title: Pontianak 100kg

Penduduk kampung cuba mencari cara untuk menghentikan gangguan tersebu

Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahaja—pulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. Mampukah Borhan dan Suhaili menunaikan satu-satunya permintaan seorang ibu yang telah berkorban demi mereka?

programme.desc: Um Bok-dong, a cyclist who won a match during the Japanese colonial era, alerts the colonial authorities and galvanizes the locals, especially freedom fighters who have invested in the races.

programme.title: THE MAN FROM NOWHERE
programme.desc: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring in hopes of saving the child who is his only friend.

programme.title: SORI: VOICE FROM THE HEART
programme.desc: A father searching for his missing daughter finds a satellite that remembers sounds from across the world. Using his daughter's voice as a beacon, the satellite helps him track her down.

programme.title: GYEONG-AH'S DAUGHTER
programme.desc: After her husband passed away, Gyeong-ah relies on her daughter Yeon-su. But they barely meet each other. One day, Gyeong-ah gets an anonymous message about Yeon-su and goes into trauma...

programme.title: THE SNITCH
programme.desc: Kang-soo was falsely accused and imprisoned. A prosecutor offered him a deal to be a snitch in exchange for a reduced sentence and Kang-soo starts to shake up the drug investigation...

programme.title: HEAR ME: OUR SUMMER
programme.desc: Yong-jun is working as a delivery man when he meets and instantly falls for Yeo-reum, the devoted sister of a gifted deaf swimmer. Yeo-reum slowly opens her heart to warm-hearted Yong-jun.

programme.title: THE KILLER
programme.desc: Ui-gang, a retired hitman, reluctantly agrees to take care of a teen-aged girl Yoon-ji, but when she becomes involved with unsavory people, he shows up to rescue her and take her home.

programme.title: RETURN OF THE MAFIA
programme.desc: 10 years ago, the mafia family welcomed the entrepreneur Dae-suh as the son-in-law. They set up a company and Dae-Suh becomes the president. The family plot a conspiracy against him...

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Fei's death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Fei's true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Cause Of Death & What's On Today
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouver—three distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Mean Talk
programme.desc: The brand-new, unconventional talk show "Mean Talk" hosts Bob Lam and Elena Kong invite celebrity guests each episode to boldly speak the truth in the most "Mean" way. Content includes the most frustrating experiences since entering the industry, the most unbelievable entertainment secrets, the most blunt and provocative remarks, and the most scandalous programs of their film and television careers! To qualify as "Mean Talk," guests must lower their standards and be "Mean" to others. Before the interview, guests must sign a "Mean Confession Voucher," promising to reveal their true feelings, answer randomly selected questions honestly, and speak the truth anonymously!

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing (Sammy) has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan (Priscilla Wong), causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai (KK Cheung), Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei (Zoie Tam). Gold digger Tong Mei-fun (Kamen Kong) is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai (Daniel Chau) and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngai's real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)

"Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. Through competitions involving food preparation, puzzle challenges, photo opportunities, and historical research, the members will guide viewers to unlock hidden gems, charming shops, nostalgic establishments, and trendy landmarks throughout Macau. The event will also introduce Macau's unique "leisure bus" routes and attractions along the way, as well as the newly launched "Macau History Exploration Guide," allowing everyone to experience the cultural charm of various historical sites.

programme.title: Running Out Of Time

In reality, Hua and Sheng secretly share a mutual respect; knowing Hua's days are numbered, Sheng devises a plan to release him…

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out …

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Liza's On Line (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Liza Wang, Sammy Leung, William So, and Dickson Yu have teamed up to create a game show, inviting members of the entertainment family and guests to participate in a "Werewolf Palace Edition" game, revealing their foolish and clever sides. Guests will also tell exaggerated "true or false stories" to attract attention, allowing for speculation on whether the events are real or fake! Following her magical touch from the previous season, Ah Jie will again stir up topics at the "Cheat Chat" dinner table. Who can bring the most entertainment? Ah Jie has a wide circle of acquaintances, inviting guests from different fields, including Mak Ling Ling, Nancy Sit, Laurinda Ho, Philip Keung, Alex Fong, and Chin Ka-lok, to compete for the best performance and generous prizes!

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)

The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the "Try It Out Team," returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the island's heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the show's spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the city's corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: Mutual Affection
programme.desc: Rich and talented scholar Sheung (Liu Wai Hung) was well-known to be a playboy. He like to fool around with his friend Por (Lam Ka Tung). One day, they met the beautiful Dip (Gigi Fu) and Por was determined to win her hand. Sheung, therefore, helped Por by courting Dip's maid Ngor (Esther Kwan). Ngor disliked Sheung at first, but Sheung managed to impress her with his wit. When Sheung married Ngor, his nightmare started. Ngor interfered with everything he did and gradually he became henpecked. Then he had an affair with the lovely and gentle Cho (Chan Mui Hing). Ngor was furious when she learnt about it and she told the Emperor. As a punishment, the Emperor ordered that Sheung could never see Ngor again…

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: The Truth Within & What's On Today
programme.desc: Episode 19 Posing as Biaozi, Han Feng conducts a deal with A-She and Mr. Meng. Qi Sizhe realizes that the drug chemist on the phone is an impostor, so the task force follows the trail to the larger network. Elsewhere, Wang Bo detonates a bomb while fleeing, leaving Zhu Qingyue gravely injured and unconscious. Wang is captured and confesses to several silencing murders. A-She is then killed, and the condition of his body, including signs of hydrofluoric-acid exposure, leads investigators to Feng Zhengxi's glass factory. Wang admits that A-She wanted to bypass Feng and contact Nuo Sha directly. Police raid the drug-production site; Feng escapes, but an underground laboratory is uncovered.

Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Episode 20 The handwriting in the glass factory's drug-manufacturing notes matches that of Qi Sizhe's mentor, Wu Yongchang, on corrections to Qi's thesis. A key molecular formula is also hidden in an anatomy book left by Li Ming. Wu insists he was only developing medicine for his wife, who has depression, but both disappear, and police conclude that Feng Zhengxi kidnapped them. Qi lures the enemy by threatening to publish the notes. After receiving a demand to exchange the formula for his mentor, he goes alone to the meeting, where his tracker is removed and he is taken to the factory. Han Feng tracks down the contact, A-Sen, and arrests him after a gunfight.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Mutual Affection
programme.desc: Rich and talented scholar Sheung (Liu Wai Hung) was well-known to be a playboy. He like to fool around with his friend Por (Lam Ka Tung). One day, they met the beautiful Dip (Gigi Fu) and Por was determined to win her hand. Sheung, therefore, helped Por by courting Dip's maid Ngor (Esther Kwan). Ngor disliked Sheung at first, but Sheung managed to impress her with his wit. When Sheung married Ngor, his nightmare started. Ngor interfered with everything he did and gradually he became henpecked. Then he had an affair with the lovely and gentle Cho (Chan Mui Hing). Ngor was furious when she learnt about it and she told the Emperor. As a punishment, the Emperor ordered that Sheung could never see Ngor again…

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Doctor is sick & What's On Today
programme.desc: Produced by the team behind News Hotline, this show flips the script on medical series by focusing on doctors who become patients themselves. It follows healthcare professionals as they face serious illnesses and health crises, highlighting how they handle vulnerability, diagnosis, and personal struggle behind the white coat.

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. programme.title: The Truth Within & What's On Today
programme.desc: Episode 20 The handwriting in the glass factory's drug-manufacturing notes matches that of Qi Sizhe's mentor, Wu Yongchang, on corrections to Qi's thesis. A key molecular formula is also hidden in an anatomy book left by Li Ming. Wu insists he was only developing medicine for his wife, who has depression, but both disappear, and police conclude that Feng Zhengxi kidnapped them. Qi lures the enemy by threatening to publish the notes. After receiving a demand to exchange the formula for his mentor, he goes alone to the meeting, where his tracker is removed and he is taken to the factory. Han Feng tracks down the contact, A-Sen, and arrests him after a gunfight.

programme.title: Doctor is sick

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Episode 21 Qi Sizhe exposes Wu Yongchang as the chemist behind the new drug and deliberately hands over an incomplete formula to buy time. Using soil Qi left behind, police locate the factory in a valley. Han Feng poses as Nuo Sha during the deal and signals the full assault. In the ensuing firefight, A-Sen shoots and kills Lin Guifen, while Feng Zhengxi is captured. Wu admits that three years earlier he anonymously reported Li Ming and caused Yu Fei's death. In the end, he chooses not to detonate the bomb and surrenders. The massive Original Diamond case is finally solved, and the two principal criminals are brought to justice. Han Feng and Qi Sizhe pay tribute to Yu Fei and decide to continue working cases side by side.

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: LUNG SEI (Kent Cheng) of the “Con Eight” is thrown in jail after being framed by Chinese Chief Detective MAN HUNG (Kent Tong) and his senior PONG FUNG (Paul Chun). MAN HUNG even steals his girlfriend PAK-HOP (Angie Cheong). Five years later, now top producer LUNG SEI not only has SHU KEI (Choi Hon Yik) and MAK KEI (James Ng) as his right-hand men, but is also reunited with his daughter SIU-YU (Ada Wong). After the murder of his fellow alum TONG WAI (Wong Pak Man), LUNG SEI believes his disciple AH-LONG (Edward Ma) is the culprit, triggering a gambling showdown between them…… SIU-YU confesses to dancing teacher PAK-HOP about her crush on aspiring director HO KA-CHUN (Dominic Ho), leading to a serendipitous reunion of PAK-HOP and LUNG SEI. PAK-HOP steals MAN HUNG's account book detailing illegal transactions and money laundering to elope with LUNG SEI, but they are crushed by MAN HUNG who is furious about this. As LUNG SEI is escorted to jail, he is released by a mystery man. They set a trap, pledging to lure the all-powerful MAN HUNG into it……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Every Step You Take
programme.desc: Due to an accident, magazine photographer SUNG TIN-CHUNG (Myolie Wu) not only lost her parents but also her sight. Nevertheless, born to be aesthete, TIN-CHUNG, who loves binge-watching TV drama, never gives up on herself. Accompanied by her boyfriend TO CHING-HENG (Jonathan Cheung) and a guide dog, she gradually rebuilds her lost confidence, and an advertising slogan "With Love, Nothing is Impossible" even becomes her motto, helping her let go of her sorrows. Unknown to her, the advertising producer, KAM YIN-CHUNG (Moses Chan), is actually her next-door neighbour. Work addict YIN-CHUNG cannot keep friends and co-workers, not even his apprentice YUEN YUEN (Elaine Yiu), who wants to resign. Feeling rather puzzled, YIN-CHUNG decides to take a long vacation and move back to his former residence, and in the meantime to get back in touch with his old friend YU KA-KING (Mak Cheung Ching). While it's the best opportunity for YIN-CHUNG to start anew, it also helps him gain a better understanding of himself. With her boyfriend having a change of heart, TIN-CHUNG is once again at the lowest ebb, fortunately, she still has YIN-CHUNG by her side as her guardian angel. Though they are poles apart in personality, the chemistry between them ignites the spark of love. So you think you can see? However, there might still be a blind spot. Whereas vision impairment doesn't deter one from seeing the light......

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.title: I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: LUNG SEI (Kent Cheng) of the “Con Eight” is thrown in jail after being framed by Chinese Chief Detective MAN HUNG (Kent Tong) and his senior PONG FUNG (Paul Chun). MAN HUNG even steals his girlfriend PAK-HOP (Angie Cheong). Five years later, now top producer LUNG SEI not only has SHU KEI (Choi Hon Yik) and MAK KEI (James Ng) as his right-hand men, but is also reunited with his daughter SIU-YU (Ada Wong). After the murder of his fellow alum TONG WAI (Wong Pak Man), LUNG SEI believes his disciple AH-LONG (Edward Ma) is the culprit, triggering a gambling showdown between them…… SIU-YU confesses to dancing teacher PAK-HOP about her crush on aspiring director HO KA-CHUN (Dominic Ho), leading to a serendipitous reunion of PAK-HOP and LUNG SEI. PAK-HOP steals MAN HUNG's account book detailing illegal transactions and money laundering to elope with LUNG SEI, but they are crushed by MAN HUNG who is furious about this. As LUNG SEI is escorted to jail, he is released by a mystery man. They set a trap, pledging to lure the all-powerful MAN HUNG into it……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Every Step You Take
programme.desc: Due to an accident, magazine photographer SUNG TIN-CHUNG (Myolie Wu) not only lost her parents but also her sight. Nevertheless, born to be aesthete, TIN-CHUNG, who loves binge-watching TV drama, never gives up on herself. Accompanied by her boyfriend TO CHING-HENG (Jonathan Cheung) and a guide dog, she gradually rebuilds her lost confidence, and an advertising slogan "With Love, Nothing is Impossible" even becomes her motto, helping her let go of her sorrows. Unknown to her, the advertising producer, KAM YIN-CHUNG (Moses Chan), is actually her next-door neighbour. Work addict YIN-CHUNG cannot keep friends and co-workers, not even his apprentice YUEN YUEN (Elaine Yiu), who wants to resign. Feeling rather puzzled, YIN-CHUNG decides to take a long vacation and move back to his former residence, and in the meantime to get back in touch with his old friend YU KA-KING (Mak Cheung Ching). While it's the best opportunity for YIN-CHUNG to start anew, it also helps him gain a better understanding of himself. With her boyfriend having a change of heart, TIN-CHUNG is once again at the lowest ebb, fortunately, she still has YIN-CHUNG by her side as her guardian angel. Though they are poles apart in personality, the chemistry between them ignites the spark of love. So you think you can see? However, there might still be a blind spot. Whereas vision impairment doesn't deter one from seeing the light......

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers.
